guest.headline: Well, I did make a list.
guest.body: Create a wish list and share it with friends and family. They can choose and reserve a gift without creating an account.
guest.createHint: You’ll need an account to create a wish list.
guest.selfHost: Want to host Oh, You Shouldn't! yourself?

mine.title: My wish lists
mine.emptyBody: Gather your gift ideas, then share them with friends and family.

newList.title: Create a wish list
newList.description: Everything can be changed later in the list settings.
newList.categoryHint: Categories help you organize your gift ideas, such as “Books, Kitchen, Hobbies”.
newList.personHint: Enter a person or a group, such as “Alex, Sam, Both of us”.

followed.title: Followed lists
followed.empty: You’re not following any lists yet. Paste a wish list link shared by a friend or family member to keep it here.
followed.unfollowBody: It will be removed from your followed lists. Any gifts you reserved on this list will stay reserved.
